description.en: Lightweight apps that you, or agents you ask, build from A2UI, Open-JSON-UI and MCP-UI pages, with entity types and relations of their own and entries in the main menu.
description.sv: Lättviktiga appar som du, eller agenter du ber, bygger av sidor i A2UI, Open-JSON-UI och MCP-UI, med egna entitetstyper och relationer och poster i huvudmenyn.

description.en: Apps built from generated UI, by you or your agents
description.sv: Appar byggda av genererat gränssnitt, av dig eller dina agenter

actions.title: Ask an agent to build an app

studio:read.en: See the apps you've built and their records
studio:read.sv: Se apparna du har byggt och deras poster

studio:write.en: Build apps for you and change their records
studio:write.sv: Bygga appar åt dig och ändra deras poster

list_apps.title: List built apps
list_apps.description: The apps the user has built with the studio: id, spacify: URI, slug, name, description, whether they're in the menu, their pages (key, title, format), entity types and relations.

get_app.title: Get an app
get_app.description: An app with everything in it: its pages with their documents, its entity types with their fields, its relations and how many records each type has.

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

save_app.title: Create or change an app
save_app.description: Create an app (no id) or change one (its id): a name, an optional slug for its address, a description, an icon (a bungalow glyph such as cube, star, book, chart, calendar, heart is 'like'), a hue 0-360, whether it shows in the main menu, and instructions saying what it is for. Then add pages, entity types and relations. Returns the app.

builder_uri.description: The spacify: URI of the agent building it (yours), so the app's other actions come to you.

save_page.title: Create or change a page
save_page.description: A page of an app, by its key (its address: /lite/<app>/<key>): a title, a format (a2ui, open_json_ui or mcp_ui), its document, an icon, whether it is a menu entry and its position. A page's document is in one of three formats. a2ui: A2UI v0.8 messages, a list of {surfaceUpdate: {surfaceId, components: [{id, component: {Text: {text: {literalString}}}}]}}, {dataModelUpdate}, {beginRendering: {surfaceId, root}}. Standard components: Text (usageHint h1-h5, caption, body), Image, Icon, Video, AudioPlayer, Row, Column, List (children: {explicitList: [ids]} or {template: {componentId, dataBinding: '/path'}}), Card (child), Tabs (tabItems), Divider, Modal, Button (child, primary, action {name, context: [{key, value}]}), CheckBox, TextField, DateTimeInput, MultipleChoice, Slider, plus Table (columns [{key,label}], rows bound to a list). open_json_ui: one nested tree {type: 'card'|'column'|'row'|'text'|'heading'|'button'|'input'|'list'|'table'|..., props, children}; values may be {path: '/x'}. mcp_ui: an HTML page as a JSON string, run in a sandboxed frame (the host's colours are the CSS variables --gondol-fg, --gondol-bg, --gondol-surface, --gondol-muted, --gondol-border, --gondol-accent and --gondol-accent-contrast); it may call window.mcpUi.tool(name, params) (the app router's tools, e.g. studio__list_records), mcpUi.prompt(text), mcpUi.link(url) and read mcpUi.data. Every page's data model has /app, /page, /types and /records/<type key> (each record: id, uri, title and its fields). Studio components: RecordList {type, title?} (the records of a type with New/Edit), RecordForm {type, submitLabel?} (creates a record). Button actions the app runs itself: create_record {type, ...fields}, update_record {id, ...fields}, delete_record {id}, new_record {type} (opens its sheet), edit_record {id}, navigate {page} or {path}, open_uri {uri}; any other action goes to the agent that built the app.

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

key.description: The page's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Saving with a key that exists changes that one.

document.description: The page: A2UI messages, an Open-JSON-UI tree, or HTML (mcp_ui) as a string.

delete_page.title: Delete a page
delete_page.description: Delete a page of an app.

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

key.description: The page's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Saving with a key that exists changes that one.

save_entity_type.title: Create or change an entity type
save_entity_type.description: An entity type of an app (recipe, plant, …) by its key, with its fields. The records of the type are entities like any other: searchable, in playlists and the library. title_field names the field that is a record's name (default the first text field).

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

key.description: The entity type's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Saving with a key that exists changes that one.

options.description: The choices of a select or multiselect field.

delete_entity_type.title: Delete an entity type
delete_entity_type.description: Delete an entity type with all its records and relations.

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

key.description: The entity type's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Saving with a key that exists changes that one.

save_relation.title: Create or change a relation
save_relation.description: A relation from one of the app's entity types to another of them (to_type) or to any entity type of the host (to_entity_type, e.g. 'organization'), one or many. A record keeps it in its data under the relation's key: the related record's id (or a spacify: URI), or a list of them for many.

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

key.description: The relation's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Saving with a key that exists changes that one.

delete_relation.title: Delete a relation
delete_relation.description: Delete a relation (records keep the values in their data).

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

key.description: The relation's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter. Saving with a key that exists changes that one.

list_records.title: List records
list_records.description: An app's records of one entity type, newest first, with their fields.

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

save_record.title: Create or change a record
save_record.description: A record of an entity type: its fields as an object (no id creates one, an id changes it; fields not given stay as they are).

app.description: The app's id, slug or identifier (from list_apps or save_app).

delete_app.title: Delete an app
delete_app.description: Delete an app with its pages, entity types and records.

mcp.instructions: The App Studio holds lightweight apps the user (or you) builds: pages of generated UI (A2UI, Open-JSON-UI or MCP-UI HTML) that show in the main menu, with entity types, relations and records of their own. When the user asks for an app, a tracker, a tool or a page, build it here: save_app, then save_entity_type for the things it keeps, save_relation between them, and save_page for each page (a list and a form are a good start). Read get_app before changing an app. A page's document is in one of three formats. a2ui: A2UI v0.8 messages, a list of {surfaceUpdate: {surfaceId, components: [{id, component: {Text: {text: {literalString}}}}]}}, {dataModelUpdate}, {beginRendering: {surfaceId, root}}.
